name: @datars/web
description: The datars runtime for the web: <datars-view src="…"> — install once, charts arrive as bundles.

scripts.build: tsc -p . && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --external:./wasm/* --outfile=dist/datars.js && mkdir -p dist/atlas && cp ../../assets/atlas/*.geojson dist/atlas/
